messages.subject: Caspian Atlas Subscription Agreement — executed
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm the Caspian Atlas Subscription and Data Licence Agreement has now been executed by both parties. A PDF of the executed agreement is attached for your files. Final landing on the negotiated points: three-year term, platform fee £285k (year one) with 4% annual uplifts, £95k data licence, liability cap at 150% of trailing 12-month fees, net 30 payment, and a 99.7% SLA target.

Thank you all — a pleasure to work on. Onboarding kicks off shortly, targeting go-live on 9 February.

Kind regards,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100 | whitfieldcarter.com
